checks.name: Current task omits server validation data, future task IDs and request keys
Another account cannot read, answer or request the explanation of an owned run
Identical request IDs are scoped to the authenticated account
Returned views do not allow a caller to mutate the stored run
An active run bounds new start keys but remains readable and accepts its old key
Concurrent identical answers create one durable attempt; another answer is rejected
Help reveals only the current exercise and marks it assisted without rewards or charges
Ordinary shift mutation and result endpoints cannot accept a first-level run
Completion, lost-response replay and reload keep level results separate from ordinary rewards

limitations: No HTTP listener, browser or DOM execution.
The role guard is reviewed separately in security-review.md.
Existing identity credential provisioning is outside this change.
